import unittest
from graph.order import topological_order

class OrderTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_dependencies_and_cycles(self):
        got=topological_order({"build":["compile"],"compile":["generate"],"test":["compile"]})
        self.assertEqual(set(got),{"build","compile","generate","test"})
        self.assertLess(got.index("generate"),got.index("compile")); self.assertLess(got.index("compile"),got.index("build"))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError): topological_order({"a":["b"],"b":["a"]})

part.text:
The implementation has been successfully repaired. The function now:

1. Returns every node after its dependencies (proper topological ordering)
2. Includes dependency-only nodes (nodes that are dependencies but not keys in the graph)
3. Raises ValueError on cycles (detects and raises exception for circular dependencies)

The fix involved:
- Adding cycle detection by tracking nodes in the current visiting path
- Including all nodes (even dependency-only nodes) in the traversal
- Properly managing the visiting and visited sets to detect cycles
- Ensuring the correct topological ordering by appending nodes after processing dependencies

All tests are now passing.
